# SocialNow OS, strict visual language

This rule has the highest visual priority for OS, Studio, login, onboarding and
orientation surfaces.

- Use TT Norms as the system typeface.
- Use generous rounded surfaces with white text on a deep navy-to-near-black
  gradient.
- SocialNow green is the focused action accent. Turquoise, neon, purple and
  flat bright blue are not system colors.
- A large atmospheric gradient may move only very slowly, 32–40 seconds per
  cycle. Never flash, hue-rotate or pulse the surface.
- Put gradient motion on a separate composited layer and disable it for
  `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
- Milo is the human guide.
- Never use emoji as interface icons. Use consistent SVG icons.
- Customer colors stay inside customer content, previews and explicitly
  approved customer-owned shell elements.

Do not introduce a route-specific visual language that competes with this
system direction.

- Always show a target creative or canvas completely in its true aspect ratio. Responsive scaling is allowed; cropping, stretching and viewport clipping are never allowed, for 4:5 or any other format.
